events.title: IP Boosts Footprint With Converting Facility Acquisition in Dover
events.body: International Paper acquires Delmarva Corrugated Packaging in Dover to expand its East Coast footprint and strengthen sustainable packaging capacity.

events.title: International Paper acquires Delmarva Corrugated Packaging
events.body: The company said the purchase fits its plan to “maximise” value for customers, shareholders and employees.
